evidence.quote: The Processor shall inform the Controller before transferring any Personal Data to a new Sub-processor.

subprocessor_notice.note: DPA section 6.2 also gives the controller 30 days to object.

evidence.quote: This DPA, the Agreement and any appendices constitutes the Parties Agreement.

dpa.note: DPA is published at timeedit.com/dpa. Section 1.3: a signed version is provided on the controller's written request.

evidence.quote: Processor is a provider of the Service which processes personal data upon the instruction of the Controller
is the controller of your personal information covered by this Privacy Policy

role.note: Processor for customer content under the DPA. Controller for website visitors and demo or webinar contacts under the privacy policy. The DPA Appendix 1 also gives TimeEdit the right to process personal data to develop and improve the Service.

evidence.quote: Last Revised December 3, 2025
TimeEdit shall keep backups for at least seven (7) days

retention_stated.note: Stated for backups only ('at least'). Personal information is kept as long as needed for the business relationship (privacy policy section 7).

evidence.quote: Processor shall promptly and in any event within ten (10) business days of the date of cessation of any Services

deletion_on_exit.note: DPA section 10.3 sets 10 business days after the services end. The Appendix 1 storage limit says deletion within 10 days of the request.

evidence.quote: Export data to your warehouse and analytics platforms.

data_export.note: Export is described for warehouses and analytics via API and webhooks. Terms section 13.3 says Usage Data may not be exported. No general export in open file formats found.

evidence.quote: Processor shall notify Controller without undue delay upon Processor becoming aware of a Personal Data Breach

breach_notice.note: DPA section 8.1 (no fixed hours). The privacy policy says authorities are notified within 72 hours.

evidence.quote: The Agreement shall be governed by Swedish law, without reference to the choice and conflict of law provisions thereof.

governing_law.note: Stockholm District Court is the first-instance court (terms section 22.1).

evidence.quote: TimeEdit AI sits above Curriculum, Workload, Scheduling and Engagement

ai_features.note: AI is described as a layer on top of the scheduling and curriculum platform, not as the core product. The vendor does not say whether AI is sold as a separate add-on.

ai_providers.note: The AI page names only customer-chosen assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) that connect via MCP. No model provider processing TimeEdit customer content is named on the pages checked. Trust centre AI pages are not readable in cache.

evidence.quote: Your data stays inside your TimeEdit environment and is never used to train external models.

trains_on_content.note: The vendor says data is never used to train external models. It does not say whether TimeEdit's own models are excluded, and DPA Appendix 1 section 6 allows processing for developing and improving the Service.

ai_zero_retention.note: No zero-retention statement for AI model providers found on the pages checked. Trust centre AI pages are not readable in cache.

ai_admin_off.note: No statement found on whether an institution admin can disable the AI features.

ai_act_statement.note: Trust centre lists an 'AI Governance' document and an 'AI Overview' page, but their contents are not readable in the cached copy.

evidence.quote: TimeEdit is certified under ISO/IEC 27001 and holds Cyber Essentials certification

certifications.note: Trust centre also shows a G-Cloud listing, which is a UK public procurement framework rather than a security certification.

evidence.quote: The Trust Center provides an overview of our security posture, detailed security controls, compliance documentation, a subprocessor list

trust_page.note: Hosted on trust.timeedit.com (SafeBase). Documents require the 'Get access' step.

evidence.quote: Encryption at rest and in transit

encryption.note: Customer-managed keys and end-to-end encryption were not found.

evidence.quote: View & download sensitive information

pentest.note: A 'Pentest Report' is listed under certifications and reports on the trust centre, behind the access request. The integrations page also says 'Regular penetration testing' without a report.

vuln_disclosure.note: No vulnerability disclosure policy or bug bounty found. /.well-known/security.txt and /security were not found (404).

incidents.note: Searched the web for breach notices, regulator decisions and fines. None found for TimeEdit. Privacy policy and trust centre were read.

evidence.quote: Service status

status_page.note: Link in the site header and academy footer. The status page itself was not opened.

evidence.quote: Enterprise SSO and identity provider integration.

sso.note: Integrations page lists SAML 2.0 with Azure AD, Okta and OneLogin as providers, and LDAP.

evidence.quote: entityID = https://se.timeedit.net/ki

federation.note: TimeEdit SP entities are registered in SWAMID (Karolinska Institutet entity cached). Search results also showed other Swedish universities. No eduGAIN listing checked.

scim.note: SCIM is not named on the integrations page, which lists SAML 2.0, LDAP and the REST API.

mfa.note: No statement on multi-factor authentication for local accounts found on the pages checked.

admin_console.note: Product list includes an 'Admin' product, but no statement on an institution admin console with usage reports was found.

evidence.quote: Complete Audit Trails

audit_logs.note: Listed as a scheduling feature. What the logs contain and who can view them was not checked.

evidence.quote: Sync course structures and schedules with your LMS.

lms_integration.note: Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle and Brightspace are named on the integrations page. Google Classroom is also named. LTI version is not stated.

vpat.note: Accessibility statement page lists no VPAT or ACR download. No VPAT found in search results.

evidence.quote: This web application is partially compliant with the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines version 2.2 AA standard

wcag_level.note: Vendor's own standard is WCAG 2.2 AA; it states partial compliance and lists non-compliances with planned fixes through 2027.

evidence.quote: This accessibility statement applies to the TimeEdit Academic Operations platform.

accessibility_statement.note: Statement last reviewed 21 September 2026. It refers to the European Accessibility Act (Directive (EU) 2019/882).

hecvat.note: Trust centre lists no HECVAT. Search results did not show one.

ferpa.note: Not stated on the pages checked. Customers named on the trust page include US schools, but no FERPA statement found.

hipaa_baa.note: No HIPAA or BAA statement found on the pages checked.

section_508.note: Accessibility statement cites UK and EU rules only. No Section 508 statement found.

state_privacy.note: No CCPA, NY Ed Law 2-d or Student Data Privacy Consortium terms found in terms, DPA or privacy policy.

uk_gdpr.note: UK is a listed hosting location for some sub-processors, but no UK transfer addendum or IDTA found.

au_privacy.note: No Australian Privacy Principles statement, IRAP assessment or Australian hosting statement found. Australia appears only as a sub-processor location.

nis2.note: No NIS2 supply-chain statement found on the pages checked.

free_plan.note: The /pricing page returned 404 in the cache. The homepage links to demos only. No free plan or trial found.
